subject: spt-gh
title: SPT.GH.------HI.P.
description: Chart on book p. 450 (TRF(CW)-22). SPT-GH (spiritual growth) is the subject; HI-P (high purpose) is the partner. From the subject: COS-P (cosmic particulars), PART (participation) and COS-DT. From COS-P: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). From EXP-DY: WOR-UNF. From PART: PHY-U-C (physical universe context). From PHY-U-C: RT-DY (reality dynamics). From COS-DT: INFO-DY and VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From VT-DY: IF-SPT (infra-spirituality). From IF-SPT: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics).
